summary.text: Kevin Christopher Riley represents the 12th District on the New York City Council, which covers the Northeast Bronx, including Williamsbridge, Wakefield, Baychester and Co-op City, and took office in 2021.
His Council biography says he is Chair of the Committee on Land Use.

paragraphs.text: Riley was born and raised in the Northeast Bronx and, according to his Council biography, worked for over a decade with Assembly Speaker Carl E. Heastie before running for the Council.
It says he previously chaired the Subcommittee on Zoning and Franchises and co-chaired the Black, Latino and Asian Caucus.
The biography says he has secured over $130 million in discretionary and capital investments for his district and passed the FDNY Diversity bills.
He is a founding member of The Dad Gang, a member of Kappa Alpha Psi Fraternity, and runs a program called Limitless Leaders at The Academy for Scholarship and Entrepreneurship in the Bronx.
